tasks.title: sleep and elapsed
tasks.statement:
Remember Instant::now(), sleep for 100 ms with tokio::time::sleep and print «прошло не меньше 100 мс: true» (compare elapsed() with Duration::from_millis(100)).

Expected output:
«прошло не меньше 100 мс: true»
tasks.hint: start.elapsed() >= Duration::from_millis(100).

tasks.title: Fix it: blocking sleep
tasks.statement:
Three tasks sleep with the blocking std::thread::sleep on a single-threaded runtime, so they run one after another. Fix the program so that they sleep at the same time: the output must be «быстро: true».

Expected output:
«быстро: true»
tasks.hint: Replace std::thread::sleep(..) with tokio::time::sleep(..).await — the task will give up the thread.

tasks.title: Three sleeps at once
tasks.statement:
Use tokio::join! to run three 100 ms sleeps at the same time and print «параллельно: true» if everything took less than 200 ms.

Expected output:
«параллельно: true»
tasks.hint: join!(sleep(d), sleep(d), sleep(d)).await is enough: join! already returns a future, and you await it with .await.

tasks.title: sleep_until
tasks.statement:
Compute a deadline: Instant::now() + 120 ms, wait for it with sleep_until and print «дедлайн достигнут: true» (Instant::now() >= deadline).

Expected output:
«дедлайн достигнут: true»
tasks.hint: time::sleep_until(deadline).await.

tasks.title: Completion order
tasks.statement:
Start three tasks: «a» sleeps 60 ms, «b» 20 ms, «c» 40 ms; after its sleep each one prints its name. Wait for all of them. The sleeps determine the output order.

Expected output:
b
c
a
tasks.hint: For each task tokio::spawn(async move { sleep(..).await; println!(..) }); then .await each JoinHandle.

tasks.title: timeout: in time
tasks.statement:
Wrap an async block (sleep 20 ms, then return 5) in a 200 ms timeout and print the result with {:?}.

Expected output:
Ok(5)
tasks.hint: time::timeout(Duration, future).await returns Result<T, Elapsed>.

tasks.title: timeout: too late
tasks.statement:
Wrap a 200 ms sleep in a 30 ms timeout. If an error comes back, print it with {} (the Display of Elapsed).

Expected output:
deadline has elapsed
tasks.hint: if let Err(e) = r { println!("{}", e); }

tasks.title: Elapsed into your own error
tasks.statement:
Write async fn fetch() -> Result<u32, String>: it waits for a 200 ms sleep through a 30 ms timeout and turns Elapsed into the string «таймаут» with map_err. Print the result with {:?}.

Expected output:
Err("таймаут")
tasks.hint: time::timeout(..).await.map_err(|_| "таймаут".to_string()) — you get a Result<(), String>.

tasks.title: Shared deadline
tasks.statement:
Set a deadline of «now + 100 ms». Perform two steps in a row, each a 60 ms sleep, and limit both with timeout_at(deadline, ..). For each one print «шаг N: ok» or «шаг N: просрочен».

Expected output:
«шаг 1: ok
шаг 2: просрочен»
tasks.hint: There is one deadline for both steps: the second step no longer makes it.

tasks.title: The first tick is immediate
tasks.statement:
Create an interval of 100 ms, wait for the first tick() and print «первый тик сразу: true» if less than 30 ms passed.

Expected output:
«первый тик сразу: true»
tasks.hint: time::interval(Duration) — the first tick() returns immediately.

tasks.title: Four ticks
tasks.statement:
An interval of 50 ms: wait for 4 ticks (the first is immediate). Print «4 тика за 140–220 мс: true» if the total time falls in that range.

Expected output:
«4 тика за 140–220 мс: true»
tasks.hint: Ticks at 0, 50, 100 and 150 ms — about 150 ms in total.

tasks.title: An interval without drift
tasks.statement:
Repeat 5 times: tick() of a 50 ms interval, then "work" (a 20 ms sleep). Print «без дрейфа: true» if everything took less than 300 ms. (With sleep(50) instead of an interval it would take about 350 ms.)

Expected output:
«без дрейфа: true»
tasks.hint: The interval's period is counted from the start, not from the end of the work.

tasks.title: MissedTickBehavior::Delay
tasks.statement:
An interval of 50 ms with MissedTickBehavior::Delay. Take the first tick, sleep for 120 ms (the ticks are late), take the second tick (it fires immediately), then measure the time until the third. Print «пауза после опоздания: true» if it is at least 45 ms.

Expected output:
«пауза после опоздания: true»
tasks.hint: iv.set_missed_tick_behavior(time::MissedTickBehavior::Delay).

tasks.title: MissedTickBehavior::Burst
tasks.statement:
The same scenario with the default behavior (Burst): the first tick, a 120 ms sleep, then two ticks in a row. Print «Burst подряд: true» if the second came less than 20 ms after the first of them.

Expected output:
«Burst подряд: true»
tasks.hint: Burst hands out the missed ticks without pauses to catch up with the schedule.

tasks.title: MissedTickBehavior::Skip
tasks.statement:
An interval of 50 ms with MissedTickBehavior::Skip. The first tick, a 120 ms sleep (the ticks at 50 and 100 are missed), then one tick() (it is late and fires immediately) and a measurement of the wait for the next tick(). Print «Skip ждёт сетку: true» if it is between 10 and 50 ms (until the tick at 150 ms).

Expected output:
«Skip ждёт сетку: true»
tasks.hint: Skip drops the missed ticks and waits for the nearest tick of the original grid.

tasks.title: reset of an interval
tasks.statement:
An interval of 100 ms: the first tick is immediate, sleep for 30 ms, call reset(), measure the next tick(). Print «после reset ждали ≥ 90 мс: true».

Expected output:
«после reset ждали ≥ 90 мс: true»
tasks.hint: reset() moves the next tick a full period from the current moment.

tasks.title: interval_at
tasks.statement:
Create interval_at(Instant::now() + 100 ms, 50 ms) and measure the first tick(). Print «первый тик позже: true» if at least 95 ms passed.

Expected output:
«первый тик позже: true»
tasks.hint: interval_at(start, period): the first tick is at the moment start.

tasks.title: Who is first
tasks.statement:
In select! wait for two sleeps: 20 ms (prints «a») and 100 ms (prints «b»). Only the first one runs.

Expected output:
a
tasks.hint: tokio::select! { _ = sleep(..) => println!(..), _ = sleep(..) => println!(..) }

tasks.title: select! as a timeout
tasks.statement:
In select! wait for a slow operation (an async block: sleep 200 ms, then return «готово») and a 50 ms sleep. If the operation won, print its value; otherwise print «тайм-аут».

Expected output:
«тайм-аут»
tasks.hint: v = async { .. } => println!("{v}"), _ = sleep(..) => println!("тайм-аут")

tasks.title: select! as an expression
tasks.statement:
Assign the result of select! to a variable: the first branch is an async block with a 30 ms sleep and the value 1, the second is a 10 ms sleep and the value 2. Print the variable.

Expected output:
2
tasks.hint: let r = tokio::select! { v = f1 => v, v = f2 => v };

tasks.title: The else branch
tasks.statement:
Declare let ready = false; and in select! put a branch with a 10 ms sleep and the condition `if ready`, plus an else branch. Print «else» from the else branch.

Expected output:
else
tasks.hint: _ = sleep(..), if ready => .., else => println!("else")

tasks.title: biased
tasks.statement:
In a loop of 100 iterations call select! with biased; and two branches that are ready at once (std::future::ready(())). Count how many times the first one won. Print «первая ветка: 100».

Expected output:
«первая ветка: 100»
tasks.hint: tokio::select! { biased; _ = ready(()) => first += 1, _ = ready(()) => {} }

tasks.title: A fair choice
tasks.statement:
Without biased;, in a loop of 1000 iterations call select! with two ready branches and count the wins of each. Print «обе выигрывали: true» if both have more than zero wins.

Expected output:
«обе выигрывали: true»
tasks.hint: By default the polling order is random, so both branches win.

tasks.title: The loser is dropped
tasks.statement:
Define a struct Guard(&'static str) with a Drop that prints «drop <name>». In select! the first branch is an async block: it creates Guard("медленный") and sleeps for 200 ms; the second is a 10 ms sleep. After select! print «после select». Look at the order in which the lines appeared: the losing future (and the Guard with it) is dropped before that.

Expected output:
«drop медленный
после select»
tasks.hint: The Guard lives inside the async block: it is released when the block is dropped.

tasks.title: Fix it: a sleep in a select! loop
tasks.statement:
A sender sends messages every 50 ms. The loop must stop 125 ms after the start, but the sleep is created anew on every iteration and never fires. Fix it: create the sleep before the loop, pin it (tokio::pin!) and pass it to select! by &mut. Expected «сообщений: 2».

Expected output:
«сообщений: 2»
tasks.hint: let deadline = sleep(..); tokio::pin!(deadline); and in select! — _ = &mut deadline => break.

tasks.title: recv is cancel safe
tasks.statement:
A sender sends the numbers 1, 2, 3 with a 40 ms pause and closes the channel. The receiver loops: select! between rx.recv() and a 15 ms sleep (the sleep only counts "empty" waits and drops recv). All messages must arrive. Print «получено: 3».

Expected output:
«получено: 3»
tasks.hint: recv() can be dropped safely: the message stays in the channel.

tasks.title: Retry with a growing pause
tasks.statement:
Write a retry: the operation fails on the first two attempts (Err("fail")) and succeeds on the third. After failures wait 20 ms, then 40 ms (doubling). For each attempt print «попытка N: fail» or «попытка N: ok», and at the end «ждали не меньше 60 мс: true».

Expected output:
«попытка 1: fail
попытка 2: fail
попытка 3: ok
ждали не меньше 60 мс: true»
tasks.hint: A loop over the attempts; after a failure sleep(delay).await and delay *= 2.

tasks.title: A timeout on each attempt
tasks.statement:
An operation attempt(n): the first two attempts sleep for 200 ms, the third returns 42 at once. Limit each attempt with a 50 ms timeout. Print «попытка N: таймаут» or «попытка N: 42».

Expected output:
«попытка 1: таймаут
попытка 2: таймаут
попытка 3: 42»
tasks.hint: for n in 1..=3 { match timeout(.., attempt(n)).await { Ok(v) => .., Err(_) => .. } }

tasks.title: Nested timeouts
tasks.statement:
An inner 30 ms timeout wraps an 80 ms sleep, an outer 200 ms timeout wraps the inner one. Print «внутренний: просрочен, внешний: ok».

Expected output:
«внутренний: просрочен, внешний: ok»
tasks.hint: The outer one returns Ok(Err(Elapsed)): it made it in time itself, the inner one did not.

tasks.title: Heartbeat
tasks.statement:
In a select! loop combine a 100 ms interval (count the ticks) and a shared 250 ms deadline (a sleep pinned before the loop). When the deadline fires, exit and print «сердцебиений: 3» (ticks at 0, 100 and 200 ms).

Expected output:
«сердцебиений: 3»
tasks.hint: tokio::pin! for the deadline; in select! — _ = &mut deadline => break and _ = iv.tick() => n += 1.
